Hi,

Thanks for reaching out, and for the kind suggestion! Dark mode isn't something we currently have listed in our product documentation, so I don't have a timeline to share on if or when it might be added.

I've made a note of your interest so it's on record. In the meantime, if eye strain is the main concern, you're welcome to use your browser's or operating system's built-in dark/night mode, which will apply a dark theme over Loopwise's interface as a workaround.

Thanks again for the feedback — it genuinely helps us understand what our customers want to see next.

Best,
Loopwise Support
